timeline.summary: Rameshbhai R Talavia disclosed promoter group’s 23,794,652 shares held as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹233.78 Cr (+11.4% YoY), net profit ₹3.97 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.45 Cr a year earlier).
Dharmaj Crop Guard reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹233.8 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹1,138.0 Cr with PAT rising 57% YoY to ₹54.7 Cr.
Dharmaj Crop Guard Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on May 29, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST via its website.
On 16 October 2026, Dharmaj Crop Guard informed that the High Court of Himachal Pradesh dismissed SML Limited's interim injunction application in a patent infringement suit.
